description: Enabled runtimes and their declared capabilities. grok-cursor + claude-code + local-script for sync multi-IDE orchestration. Async-only runtimes remain extension contracts until exercised.

grok-cursor.notes: Primary runtime for Grok sessions in Cursor. Worktrees via New-TaskWorktree.ps1 under .grok/worktrees/. Scope via Assert-EditScope in worker prompts. Projection to .grok/skills and .grok/rules. Orchestrator uses gloam-* skills; workers via Task tool + agents/grok-*.md prompts.

claude-code.notes: Primary trusted runtime. Supports SubagentStart/Stop hooks, worktree.baseRef=head, per-agent Edit/Write scope hooks. Used for Orchestrator (main session), all worker roles in sync mode.

local-script.notes: For bounded, non-editing work: invoking project build/test scripts, simple file transforms that produce stdout/structured output, log collection. Output is raw; requires Normalize-RuntimeResult.ps1 + validation before state transition. Cannot be used for Coder (fails safety floor) or final integration Critic.

notes: Safety floor is enforced in routing.json logic and Orchestrator: edit_code requires can_edit_files + can_use_worktree + can_enforce_scope; final Critic requires can_run_tests + repo_read. local-script is intentionally limited so it cannot accidentally mutate state or source.
